1.text: Indirimbo ya Asafu yahimbishijwe ubwenge.Bwoko bwanjye, nimwumve amategeko yanjye,Nimutegere amatwi amagambo yo mu kanwa kanjye.

2.text: Ndabumbura akanwa mbacire imigani,Ndavuga amagambo aruhije ya kera.

3.text: Ibyo twumvise tukamenya,Ibyo ba sogokuruza batubwiye,

4.text: Ntituzabihisha abuzukuruza babo,Tubwire ab'igihe kizaza ishimwe ry'Uwiteka,N'imbaraga ze n'imirimo itangaza yakoze.

5.text: Kuko yakomeje guhamya mu Bayakobo,Yashyizeho itegeko mu Bisirayeli,Iryo yategetse ba sogokuruza,Ngo babibwire abana babo,

6.text: Kugira ngo ab'igihe kizaza bazabimenye,Ni bo bana bazavuka,Ngo na bo bazahaguruke,Babibwire abana babo,

7.text: Kugira ngo biringire Imana,Kandi batibagirwa ibyo Imana yakoze,Ahubwo bitondere amategeko yayo.

8.text: Be kuba nka ba sekuruza,Ab'igihe cy'ibigande cy'abagome,Batiboneza imitima,Imitima yabo idakiranukira Imana.

9.text: Abefurayimu batwaye intwaro n'imiheto,Basubiye inyuma ku munsi w'intambara.

10.text: Ntibitondeye isezerano ry'Imana,Banze kugendera mu mategeko yayo.

11.text: Bibagiwe ibyo yakoze,N'imirimo yayo itangaza yaberetse.

12.text: Yakoreye ibitangaza mu maso ya ba sekuruza,Mu gihugu cya Egiputa, mu kigarama cy'i Zowani.

13.text: Yatandukanije inyanja ibacisha hagati yayo,Ihagarika amazi nk'ikirundo.

14.text: Kandi ku manywa yabayobozaga igicu,Ijoro ryose ikabayoboza kumurika k'umuriro.

15.text: Yasaturiye ibitare mu butayu,Ibanywesha amazi menshi ava ikuzimu.

16.text: Kandi yavushije amasōko mu gitare,Itembesha amazi nk'imigezi.

17.text: Ariko bagumya kuyicumuraho,Kugomerera Isumbabyose mu gihugu gikakaye.

18.text: Bagerageresha Imana imitima yabo,Bayigerageresha gusaba ibyokurya byo guhaza kwifuza kwabo.

19.text: Bagaya Imana bati“Mbese Imana ibasha gutunganiriza ameza mu butayu?

20.text: Dore yakubise cya gitare amazi aradudubiza,Imigezi iratemba.Mbese yabasha kuduha n'umutsima?Izabonera ubwoko bwayo inyama?”

21.text: Ni cyo cyatumye Uwiteka arakara abyumvise,Umuriro ugacanwa wo gutwika Abayakobo,Umujinya ugacumba ku Bisirayeli,

22.text: Kuko batizeye Imana,Kandi ntibiringire agakiza kayo.

23.text: Ariko itegeka ibicu byo hejuru,Ikingura inzugi z'ijuru,

24.text: Ibagushiriza manu yo kurya,Ibaha ku masaka yo mu ijuru,

25.text: Bose barya umutsima w'abakomeye,Iboherereza ibyokurya byo kubahaza rwose.

26.text: Ihuhisha mu ijuru umuyaga uturutse iburasirazuba,Iyoboza ubutware bwayo umuyaga uturutse ikusi.

27.text: Kandi ibamanurira inyama nyinshi nk'umukungugu,N'inyoni ziguruka nyinshi,Zimeze nk'umusenyi wo ku nyanja,

28.text: Izigusha hagati mu rugo rw'amahema yabo,Zigota aho bari.

29.text: Nuko bararya barahaga cyane,Yabahaye ibyo bifuje.

30.text: Bari bataratandukana no kwifuza kwabo,Ibyokurya byabo byari bikiri mu kanwa kabo,

31.text: Umujinya w'Imana urabahagurukira,Wica abanini bo muri bo,Urimbura abasore bo mu Bisirayeli.

32.text: Nubwo ibyo byababayeho bagumya gucumura,Ntibizera imirimo yayo itangaza,

33.text: Bituma irangiza iminsi yabo nk'umwuka,N'imyaka yabo iyirangirisha kurimbuka kubatunguye.

34.text: Uko yabicaga babaririzaga ibyayo,Bakagaruka bakazindukira gushaka Imana,

35.text: Bakibuka yuko Imana ari yo gitare cyabo,Kandi yuko Imana Isumbabyose ari umucunguzi wabo.

36.text: Ariko bayishyeshyeshaga akanwa kabo,Bakayibeshyeshya indimi zabo,

37.text: Kuko imitima yabo itayitunganiye,Kandi batari abanyamurava mu isezerano ryayo.

38.text: Ariko yo kuko yuzuye imbabazi,Ibabarira gukiranirwa kwabo ntiyabarimbura,Kandi kenshi isubiza inyuma uburakari bwayo,Ntikangure umujinya wayo wose.

39.text: Nuko yibuka yuko ari abantu buntu,N'umuyaga uhita ntugaruke.

40.text: Erega ni kenshi bayigomereraga mu butayu,Bayibabarizaga ahatagira abantu,

41.text: Bagahindukira bakagerageza Imana,Bakarakaza Iyera ya Isirayeli.

42.text: Ntibibukaga ukuboko kwayo,Cyangwa umunsi yabacunguriyemo, ikabakiza abanzi,

43.text: Kandi yuko yashyize ibimenyetso byayo muri Egiputa,N'ibitangaza byayo mu kigarama cy'i Zowani,

44.text: Igahindura inzuzi z'ab'aho amaraso,N'imigezi yabo ntibabashe kuyinywaho.

46.text: Kandi iha ubuzikira imyaka yabo,N'imirimo yabo iyiha inzige.

47.text: Yicisha imizabibu yabo urubura,N'imishikima yabo iyicisha imbeho.

48.text: Itanga inka zabo ngo zicwe n'urubura,N'imikumbi yabo ngo ikubitwe n'inkota zotsa.

49.text: Ibatera uburakari bwayo bukaze,Umujinya n'uburakari n'ibyago,Umutwe w'abamarayika b'abarimbuzi.

50.text: Iharurira uburakari bwayo inzira,Ntiyakiza ubugingo bwabo urupfu,Ahubwo iha indwara yanduza ubugingo bwabo.

51.text: Ikubita abana b'imfura bose bo muri Egiputa irabica,Abo gukomera kwabo kwatangiriyeho bo mu mahema ya Hamu.

52.text: Ariko ubwoko bwayo, ubwayo ibushorera nk'intama ibakurayo,Ibayoborera mu butayu nk'umukumbi.

53.text: Ibayobora amahoro bituma badatinya,Maze inyanja irengera ababisha babo.

54.text: Kandi ibajyana ku rugabano rw'ahera hayo,Kuri uyu musozi ukuboko kwayo kw'iburyo kwahinduye,

55.text: Yirukana amahanga imbere yabo,Ibagereshereza imigozi igihugu cyabo kuba umwandu wabo,Iturisha imiryango y'Abisirayeli mu mahema y'abo ngabo.

56.text: Ariko Abisirayeli bagerageza Imana Isumbabyose barayigomera,Ntibitondera ibyo yahamije,

57.text: Ahubwo basubira inyuma,Bava mu isezerano nka ba sekuruza,Barateshuka nk'umuheto uhemukira nyirawo.

58.text: Kuko bayirakarishije gusengera ahantu habo ho ku mpinga z'imisozi,Bayiteje ishyari ibishushanyo byabo bibajwe.

60.text: Bituma ireka ubuturo bw'i Shilo,Ari bwo hema yabambye hagati y'abantu.

61.text: Itanga imbaraga zayo ngo zijyanwe ho iminyago,N'icyubahiro cyayo ngo gifatwe n'amaboko y'ababisha,

62.text: Kandi itanga n'abantu bayo ngo bicwe n'inkota,Irakarira umwandu wayo.

63.text: Umuriro utwika abasore babo,Abakobwa babo ntibagira indirimbo y'ubukwe,

64.text: Abatambyi babo bicwa n'inkota,Abapfakazi babo ntibababorogera.

65.text: Maze Umwami Imana irakanguka nk'uwasinziriye,Nk'intwari ivugishwa cyane na vino,

66.text: Ikubita ababisha bayo, ibasubiza inyuma,Ibakoza isoni zidashira.

67.text: Kandi yanga ihema rya Yosefu,Ntiyatoranya umuryango wa Efurayimu

68.text: Ahubwo itoranya umuryango wa Yuda,Umusozi wa Siyoni yakunze.

69.text: Yubaka Ahera hayo hadatsembwa nk'ijuru,Nk'isi yashimangiye iteka.

70.text: Kandi itoranya Dawidi umugaragu wayo,Imukura mu ngo z'intama,

71.text: Kandi imukura ku gukurikira intama zonsa,Kugira ngo aragire Abayakobo ubwoko bwayo,Abisirayeli umwandu wayo.

72.text: Nuko abaragirisha umutima utunganye,Abayoboza ubwenge bw'amaboko ye.
